detail.longDescription: This video is wild (parent -> teacher subliminal learning): https://www. youtube.com/watch?v=NUAb6zHXqdI I can't quite articulate why this make sense to me, but if feels like if you started searching for patterns in some n dimensional space, you've started clustering somewhere, passing on that knowledge would have the space embedded in it, and going "in a direction" would start from the starting space. Where if you were not taught your space and direction might be completely different and lead to way different outcomes. I feel like there is an analogy to humans in here as well - and "group think". Or why having a mentor or supervisor can be useful or harmful. Really thought provoking video that one. # ai # machinelearning # maths # academic # academia # llm
